page_title: PSG 3-1 REN | PSG v Rennes 27/09/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.

90+5' What a miss! Randal Kolo Muani (PSG) is left standing right in front of goal with only the keeper to beat after a clever pass, but he somehow contrives to toe poke the ball just past the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Rennes.
90+3' Mahamadou Nagida (Rennes) is disappointed with himself because he got into a good area but produced a poor cross.
90+2' Neat passing move from Rennes in order to create new attacking opportunities.
90' 7 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
88' Celebrations are cut short for Rennes as the referee indicates NO GOAL after the VAR review shows it was handball!
88' The Rennes players halt their celebrations as referee Hakim Ben El Hadj Salem makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was a handball in the build-up play.
87' Goal! Alidu Seidu (Rennes) fires the rebound inside the right post after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 3:2.
87' Alidu Seidu (Rennes) strikes the ball towards the right side of the goal despite being in a difficult position, but his shot is intercepted by one of the defenders.
84' Albert Gronbaek (Rennes) is unlucky with a goal-bound effort from the edge of the box. A brilliant save by Matvey Safonov stops the ball from going inside the left post.
82' The referee allows time for a substitution. Ousmane Dembele will be replaced by Ibrahim Mbaye (PSG).
79' Julien Stephan appears to have said too much and referee Hakim Ben El Hadj Salem comes over and theatrically shows him a yellow card.
78' Here is a change. Azor Matusiwa is going off and Julien Stephan gives the last tactical orders to Albert Gronbaek (Rennes).
78' Adrien Truffert goes off the pitch and Mahamadou Nagida (Rennes) comes on.
77' Mikayil Faye (Rennes) commits a foul and Hakim Ben El Hadj Salem immediately signals a free kick.
77' The resulting corner from Amine Gouiri (Rennes) comes to nothing.
76' The ball goes behind for a corner. Rennes will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.

76' Arnaud Kalimuendo (Rennes) takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's not a big threat for the goalkeeper as his effort is blocked by a defender. The ball goes out of play. Rennes are awarded a corner kick.
75' 3 - 1 Goal! Arnaud Kalimuendo (Rennes) wins the battle of wills and sends an unstoppable penalty past Matvey Safonov into the bottom right corner.
74' Arnaud Kalimuendo (Rennes) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
73' The ball spins up and hits the hand of Lucas Beraldo (PSG) after he fails to control it and the referee blows his whistle for a foul. No point in arguing there. Rennes will take a penalty kick.
73' The referee awards a corner and Ludovic Blas (Rennes) goes over to take it.
72' Matvey Safonov is equal to the effort from the edge of the box by Amine Gouiri (Rennes), pushing the ball around the post to safety. The referee signals a corner kick to Rennes.
69' Substitution. Milan Skriniar (PSG) has come on for Marquinhos.
69' The game has come to an end for Bradley Barcola. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Randal Kolo Muani (PSG).
69' Luis Enrique prepares a substitution. Fabian Ruiz is replaced by Senny Mayulu (PSG).
68' 3 - 0 Goal! Achraf Hakimi shows great vision to find Bradley Barcola (PSG) with a cheeky pass inside the box, and his first-time shot is precise and sails into the bottom left corner. 3:0.
66' Julien Stephan has decided to make a change. Mikayil Faye (Rennes) replaces Leo Ostigard.
65' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Glen Kamara (Rennes) replaces Baptiste Santamaria.
65' Christopher Wooh (Rennes) receives a yellow card for a nasty tackle.
64' Bradley Barcola (PSG) creates a good chance for himself and goes for goal from mid-range, but he misses the right post by a whisker. The ball goes out of play and Rennes will have a goal kick.

61' Fabian Ruiz (PSG) blows a clear opportunity to score a goal. He was one-on-one with Steve Mandanda inside the six-yard box and attempted to put the ball into the left side of the target, but was denied by a great save.
59' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Lorenz Assignon walks off the pitch to be replaced by Hans Hateboer (Rennes).
58' 2 - 0 An unlucky rebound falls to Kang-In Lee (PSG) and he scores with a bullet header.
58' Bradley Barcola (PSG) fires a brilliant shot from the edge of the box, but the effort rattles the right post! It could have been a superb goal.
57' Bradley Barcola (PSG) hits a first-time shot from the edge of the box low towards the middle of the goal, but Steve Mandanda is equal to the task and makes a comfortable save.
56' The current number of shots on goal is 2:1.
54' PSG control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
52' Warren Zaire-Emery (PSG) is cautioned by the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
51' Bradley Barcola (PSG) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
50' Adrien Truffert (Rennes) commits a rough challenge and Hakim Ben El Hadj Salem blows his whistle for a foul.
48' The assistant referee raises his flag and the referee blows his whistle. Achraf Hakimi (PSG) puts the ball into the net, but he is flagged for offside.
46' The second half has just started.
45+2' Hakim Ben El Hadj Salem blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45' The fourth official shows 2 min. of added time.
45' Dangerous play by Lucas Beraldo (PSG). Hakim Ben El Hadj Salem blows his whistle for a foul.
44' The shot by Arnaud Kalimuendo (Rennes) from the edge of the box low towards the middle of the goal lacks power and is easily saved by Matvey Safonov.
43' The ball is cleared after Bradley Barcola (PSG) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
42' Lorenz Assignon (Rennes) goes into the referee's book for dissent.
41' Hakim Ben El Hadj Salem interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Kang-In Lee (PSG).
39' This corner kick is taken with a short pass by Kang-In Lee (PSG).
39' Bradley Barcola (PSG) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. PSG earn a corner.
39' The PSG players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
36' Kang-In Lee (PSG) will take the corner.

36' That's unlucky! Fabian Ruiz (PSG) beautifully controls a pass and from the edge of the box drills a shot in on goal, but it's inadvertently blocked by a defender and cleared. PSG force their opponents to concede a corner.
33' Kang-In Lee (PSG) takes the corner but only sends it into a huddle of the defenders and one of them makes a good clearance.
31' Baptiste Santamaria (Rennes) gets a yellow card.

30' 1 - 0 Brilliant finish! Bradley Barcola (PSG) perfectly collected a pass on the edge of the penalty area from Ousmane Dembele, then produced a nice strike into the bottom right corner. The score is 1:0.
29' 70:30 – this is the current ball possession ratio.
26' Poor challenge! Warren Zaire-Emery (PSG) is penalised for tripping and Hakim Ben El Hadj Salem blows his whistle. Rennes will take a free kick.
25' Great teamplay by Rennes as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
21' PSG seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
19' Achraf Hakimi (PSG) latches onto a pass inside the box, steps inside his marker and smacks a shot against the crossbar.
15' Ludovic Blas (Rennes) nutmegs the defender on the edge of the box and lashes in a shot at goal that flies well wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for PSG.
15' The PSG players are exchanging some short passes.
14' Nothing comes of the resulting corner from Kang-In Lee (PSG). The defence is alert and manages to cut it out.
13' Kang-In Lee (PSG) looks like he will be the one to take the corner kick.
13' Ousmane Dembele (PSG) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared. Corner kick. PSG will have an opportunity.
11' Ludovic Blas (Rennes) takes the corner kick and sends the ball among a huddle of players inside the penalty area, but one of the defenders clears it to safety.
9' Azor Matusiwa (Rennes) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.

6' Ousmane Dembele (PSG) dribbled past his opponents before finding himself in a great position to strike. But his low attempt from just outside of the box went straight towards the middle of the goal and Steve Mandanda made a comfortable save.
6' The goal by PSG is DISALLOWED on the advice of the video assistant referee due to an offside.
4' Wait! Referee Hakim Ben El Hadj Salem has indicated he is going to review the PSG goal using VAR. It’s probably to see if there was an offside in the build-up.
4' Goal! Lucas Beraldo gets to the ball and heads it over the defence to Marquinhos (PSG), who meets it nicely and fires in into the back of the net. 1:0.
3' The ball is out of play. PSG will have a chance to score from a corner.

3' A defender unwittingly blocks the ball on the line after a snap shot from Fabian Ruiz (PSG) inside the box following a slide rule pass. The ball goes out for a corner. PSG can continue in their attacking effort.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
Hakim Ben El Hadj Salem is introduced as the referee for today's match.
Show lineups The starting XIs were already announced and you can go through them in the Lineups section.
